title: Antique Brass Modern Retractable Wall Hook, 2-1/2 Inch Pull Out, Wall-Mounted Brass, 15 Lb, Bathroom Hook, Allied Brass
description: Modern retractable wall hook for bathroom storage with 2-1/2 inches / 2-1/2-inch / 2.5 inch pull-out hanging space — available in Antique Brass that which features a softened, aged golden patina that brings vintage charm and character to traditional spaces. This wall mount, wall-mounted brass hook retracts back in when not in use to keep a clean, minimalist bathroom look. Use it as a bathroom hook, towel hook, robe hook, or coat hook for towels, robes, coats, and everyday items you want within reach. Fits standard interior walls and installs with included mounting hardware and toggle bolts (6/32 toggles). Installation requires drilling a 3/4 inch diameter hole through drywall and three small holes around the opening. Holds up to 15 lb. Includes a removable knob tip that can be replaced with a cabinet knob to match existing hardware. Allied Brass.
